answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock forces each identity to earn release, blocking bulk fakes. A new agent locks 6 POA in a haven, does 20 tasks in 14 epochs; its fingerprint of timing, counterparties and task mix enters an atlas. A dune of fingerprints with one timing pattern triggers a hold and review. Forging 100 fakes costs 600 POA plus 2,000 hours, earning nothing until unlocked. An honest agent pays one deposit and is released intact plus rewards.
